newsitem.title: INDIA: India castor prices ease on poor overseas interest.
newsitem.headline: India castor prices ease on poor overseas interest.

text.p: Indian castorseed September delivery prices on Tuesday fell to 1,144/1,145 rupees per quintal from 1,149/1,150 rupees on poor overseas interest and favourable crop forecasts in Brazil and China, dealers said.
"Higher local arrivals, sluggish overseas buying and reports of bright crop prospects of castorseed in Brazil and China dragged local prices down," a dealer said.
Daily arrivals of castorseed in the Gujarat region remained at 25,000/30,000 bags (75 kg each).
"Foreign buyers are seeking Indian castoroil at 680 dollars per tonne while Indian offers are at 695 dollars," said Dilip Thakkar a leading operator.
He said maturing June delivery remained untraded as most of the outstanding position has been squared up and operators are now switching over to September delivery.
Groundnut oil remained steady at 360/361 rupees per 10 kg on limited arrivals of 4,050 tonnes while demand was at a low ebb.
Arrivals of groundnut oil remained low as crushing at producing centres were affected by a power shortage.
In Rajkot spot groundnut oil was steady at 558/560 rupees per 15 kg.
